implementation_strategy: Execute the preregistered paired confirmatory run using the hosted_netops_gvr_v1 adapter. For each of the N=240 preregistered tasks (stratified 80/80/80 across small/medium/large topologies) perform one shared baseline generation call (condition=baseline) and, if the verifier fails, perform at most one guarded repair call (condition=guarded). All configuration parsing, canonicalization, verifier checks, contamination-detection, flagging, auditing, logging, retries, and scoring are deterministic codepaths in the repository and exercised on CPU; no human labour is used. Record exact provider model id/version/timestamps for every API call. Preserve all raw outputs, canonicalized configs, line-hashes, and verifier traces in the public artifact repository.
public_resources: Public synthetic topology/policy corpus (to be published with provenance alongside study artifacts)
Repository: parser + canonicalizer + deterministic verifier + unit tests (will be published)
model_and_version_plan: gpt-5-mini (hosted via openai_responses; exact runtime metadata recorded at execution start)
task_manifest_strategy: Use the preregistered public synthetic corpus; sample deterministically with fixed RNG seed stratified into three topology-size strata (80 per stratum). Exclude only tasks failing deterministic schema validation prior to prompting; log exclusions.
transformation_manifest_strategy: Use repository deterministic parser/canonicalizer to convert textual LLM outputs to verifier inputs; run unit-test suite (≥100 canonical cases) before execution. Parser parse-failures are auto-marked parse-fail and counted as verifier-fail for that iteration.
randomisation_plan: Stratified sampling with fixed seed (42) per stratum to select the 80 tasks; within-stratum order randomized per seed but recorded. All sampling and seed values recorded in the execution manifest.
caching_plan: Cache canonicalizer outputs and verifier results keyed by task & model-output SHA256 to avoid redundant verifier runs. Cache stored with artifact hashes and included in public artifact release. Cache is CPU-disk based (Docker-supported if used) and does not require local GPU.
failure_recovery_plan: Technical model/API failures: automatic exponential-backoff retries up to 2 retries (total 3 attempts per call). If still failing, mark call as 'technical failure' and exclude task from primary paired analysis per preregistration; include in sensitivity analyses as described. Parser or canonicalizer deterministic failures count as parse-fail and are treated as verifier-fail for that iteration; logged with error codes. All restarts, halts, and automated fixes are deterministically logged.
result_schema: paired_binary_episode_v1 (one episode per task per condition: baseline and guarded; canonicalized config; verifier pass/fail boolean; parser status; contamination flags; per-call metadata: model id, timestamp, cost, retries).
estimated_compute_notes: Totals: N=240 tasks. Baseline calls = 240 (one per task). Expected baseline fail rate ≈30% → expected repair calls ≈72. Total estimated model calls = 240 + 72 = 312. Per-adapter hard cap = 240*2 = 480 maximum model calls (one baseline + one repair per task). All verifier runs execute on CPU; verifier runtime per config is <1s in unit tests—wall-clock execution fits within the 7-day limit. Estimates include logging/retry overhead; all counts recorded in execution manifest.
